Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Junior Project Leader (f-m-d) Engineering -
Milwaukee® Key Responsibilities: Lead and develop NPD projects in
EMEA in accordance with our development process on all technical
aspects for design and development Coordinate technical aspects in the
NPD Project for Professional Products EMEA or ROW driven Check
NPQ/PEAC/CTQs and coordinate results between Product Management,
Quality, Regulatory, Reliability and After Sales and prepare for EMEA
sign-off to provide a technical specification meeting to the customer
expectation Participate in the 2D/3D design reviews with Product
Management and Engineering Work closely with external partners and
vendors within the New Development Project Coordinate the Sample
Inspection Report with Product Management (EMEA), Engineering and
Quality teams (PRC) to support the pilot run approval and the
subsequent release for mass production Determine with team on
temporary deviation and releases Make technical file available for TTI
EMEA on product level and check integrity of the technical file Assess
and sign off temporary deviation for engineering if necessary, during
mass production Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
technical education, preferably in mechanical or engineering or a
related field Ideally experience in project management and product
development Good understanding of technical processes in engineering
like product development, technical documentation Ideally experienced
in Personal Protective Equipment or Power Tools business Excellent
command of German and English, both written and spoken, another
European language is of advantage Extensive experience with MS Office
application Knowledge in CAD system Willingness to travel according to
business need (20% approx.) Your perks: An interesting position with
an attractive company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu
Company pension scheme Free parking spaces directly next to the office

Randstad is one of the world's leading talent companies with the
ambition to be the world's most equitable and specialized talent
company. Through our "partner for talent" corporate strategy, we find,
develop and connect specialized talents with companies - worldwide,
locally and always at a high speed. We build high-quality, diverse,
and agile teams, while individuals can enjoy a rewarding career path
with equitable opportunities.

Randstad Professional is one of Randstad's four specializations
and focuses on the placement of specialists and managers in the
future-oriented sectors of IT, Engineering, Life Science and Office.

Our mission: We bring people together! We are currently offering an
attractive position as CTSU trial manager with one of our customers

- a pharmaceutical company in Biberach. A fair compensation and
personal support are of course included. You have a master's
degree in natural science? Then you are a perfect match for us – we
look forward to hearing from you! Apply online now! We welcome
applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of any
disabilities.
- Responsible for global Supply Chain activities for Investigational
Medicinal Products (IMPs) of national and international Phase I-IV
clinical trials in the Therapeutic Area General Medicine
- Function as the main point of contact to Clinical Operations and
Clinical Development for assigned trials, ensuring the timely and cost
efficient provision of clinical supplies
- Act as the responsible leader of the CTSU trial team within the
matrix structure, ensuring cross-functional collaboration and
development of interfaces for all Supply Chain activities on the basis
of business, regulatory and industry needs
- Provide input to clinical trial protocols and bulk demands incl.
comparator and non-IMP commercial products, to specific packaging
designs and efficient distribution strategies
- Support investigations as Subject Matter Expert for assigned trials
- Master's degree in natural sciences or similar disciplines or
completed vocational training with experience in clinical trials
- Several years experiences in clinical trial supplies or related
business
- Experience in working in an international environment, as well as
team leading and project management experiences
- Ideally good knowledge and understanding of the regulatory and
GMP/GCP requirements for IMPs
- Ability to interpret complex project requirements
- Good software skills (MS Office)
- Fluent English and good German skills, both spoken and written
- Strong problem solving capabilities with the willingness to make
decisions and the ability to drive results
- Very good communication, negotiation and presentation skills
- Ability to work independently as well as in a team
- Performance-based salary package depending on qualifications and
professional experience
- Extensive social benefits, incl. Christmas and holiday bonuses
- Company pension scheme contribution after the end of the
probationary period
- Up to 30 days vacation per year
- Option of permanent employment with our business partner
- A wide range of employee benefits/perks

- community

- Proven ability to produce documentation for processes and procedures
- Proven ability to work and lead in cross-architecture teams
- Capability to influence without formal authority
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong cultural awareness and intercultural competencies
- Ability to build trusted relationships with key stakeholders
- Persistence, self-motivation and willingness to work under pressure
- Proven ability to deliver against challenging timelines
- Ability to speak and write in English fluently

WORK EXPERIENCE

- Very good understanding of infrastructure and security related topics
- Minimum 5 years of software development experience in all phases of SDLC,
- including hands-on experience with infrastructure, application or database
- migration
- Experience deploying technical infrastructure at a global scale
- Balanced expertise in both full stack application development and infrastructure
- development
- Thorough understanding of infrastructure firewalls, load balancers, storage,
- monitoring, security, IAM etc. and have experience with orchestration to develop a
- cloud solution
- Strong experience in operating systems administration and security engineering
- Working knowledge of Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD tools, and GIT is required
- Working knowledge of Log Correlation, Vulnerability Management, Web
- Application Testing concepts is a plus
- Familiarity with managing and securing Kubernetes environments
- Exposure to either NIST, ISO, or other compliance frameworks

As a Sovereign Cloud Architect & Advisor (f/m/d), you will be at the forefront of enabling customers to modernize their IT landscapes through trusted cloud solutions that meet regulatory, security, and compliance requirements. You will serve as a strategic partner, trusted advisor, and cloud visionary, helping customers navigate complex hybrid environments and design cloud strategies that accelerate innovation while preserving compliance. Working with customers, partners, and internal experts, you will:

- Define sovereign cloud strategies that balance innovation, security, compliance, and operational excellence.
- Build transformation roadmaps that guide customers from their current landscape to a future-ready cloud operating model.
- Architect trusted hybrid and multi-cloud solutions across platforms such as SAP Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
- Enable resilient and compliant environments that support business continuity, data sovereignty, and regulatory requirements.
- Create lasting customer relationships as a strategic advisor throughout their cloud transformation journey.

What you bring

- 10+ years of customer-facing SAP consulting experience and 8+ years in enterprise architecture, solution design, or SAP implementation, with exposure to pre-sales, service delivery, ITSM, and SAP operations.
- Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage executives, architects, and technical stakeholders.
- Deep knowledge of SAP solutions, industry offerings, product roadmaps, and solution dependencies.
- Solid expertise in cloud infrastructure and platform technologies, including virtualization, compute, networking, storage, and hybrid/multi-cloud architectures.
- Hands-on experience with Hyperscaler such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and SAP Cloud Infrastructure (SCI); relevant certifications are highly valued.
- Extensive SAP technology background, including SAP HANA, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, OS/DB migrations, SAP BTP, HANA Cloud, AI and enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
- Understanding SAP BTP, integration architectures, cybersecurity, compliance, data privacy, and sovereign cloud principles; experience in regulated industries or the public sector is a plus.
- Fluency in German and English due to relevant stakeholders; additional languages are an advantage.
- You are willing to undergo personal security clearance (a government process).

During the interview process the following skills will be evaluated as pre-requisite for the role: Cloud Architecture, Cloud platform system, Effective Communication & Collaboration, Hybrid Architecture & Resiliency, Cloud Security, Complex problem solving, Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping.

Where you belong

Sovereign Cloud solutions help organizations meet evolving data privacy, residency, compliance, and  sovereignty requirements while accelerating their cloud transformation journey. The Sovereign Services & Delivery (SS&D) business unit, part of SAP's Customer Value Group, specializes in delivering end-to-end sovereign cloud solutions for sectors like public, highly regulated industries etc.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for an experienced and passionate Head of Structures to lead and further develop our growing structures team.In this role, you will take overall technicalresponsibility for the structural development of our VTOL aircrafts, fro initial concepts and structural architecture through detailed design, analysis, manufacturing support and structural testing.You will define the structural strategy, make key technical decisions and ensure that lightweight, robust, manufacturable and certifiable structures are developed inline with the overall aircraft and programme objectives. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of structural design and analysis engineers while remaining closely involved in design reviews, prototype manufacturing, aircraft integration and structural testing.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• You lead and further develop the structures team and take overall technical responsibility for the aircraft structure, from preliminary design through detailed design, manufacturing, testing and flight operations
• You define and maintain the structural architecture, load paths, design principles and material concepts and lead the development of primary and secondary structures, including fuselage, wings, empennage, propulsion-supporting structures, landing gear interfaces and system installations
• You define structural requirements, verification methods, test strategies and acceptance criteria and coordinate analyses covering strength, stiffness, stability, fatigue, damage tolerance, vibration and dynamic behaviour
• You plan, review and support coupon, component, subassembly and full-scale structural tests and ensure compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements, certification objectives and internal development processes
• You coordinate closely with Loads, Flight Physics, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Testing, Certification and Quality to develop lightweight, robust, manufacturable and integrated structural solutions.
• You review and approve structural concepts, calculations, drawings, reports and test documentation and manage structural risks, deviations, design changes and corrective actions
• You actively support prototype manufacturing, structural assembly, aircraft integration, ground and flight testing and the resolution of practical issues, structural findings, damage or failures directly on the hardware
• You establish and continuously improve engineering processes, methods, tools and documentation standards and support the selection and coordination of external development and manufacturing partners
• You translate the structural development roadmap into clear priorities and responsibilities and support the growth of the team through recruiting, onboarding, mentoring and technical development

WHAT YOU BRING
• You hold an academic degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering or a comparable technical course of study
• Several years of professional experience in aircraft structures, including responsibility for structural design, analysis or verification, form part of your background
• Strong experience in the development of lightweight aircraft structures from initial concept through detailed design and testing is something you bring to the table
• You have extensive knowledge of composite, metallic and sandwich structures, including relevant manufacturing and joining technologies
• Structural mechanics, load paths, finite element analysis, strength, stability, fatigue and structural testing form part of your technical expertise
• You bring strong hands-on experience in the manufacturing, assembly, modification, repair or testing of aircraft structures and prototypes
• You are comfortable working directly with prototypes and hardware and enjoy resolving practical structural and integration challenges together with the workshop and test teams
• Leading a multidisciplinary engineering team while remaining technically and practically involved is something you are capable of
• You are able to make technical decisions and balance weight, performance, safety, manufacturability, cost and schedule
• Target-oriented self-management comes naturally to you, along with a structured and pragmatic working style
• Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership and technical writing skills complete your profile.
• Fluent English rounds out your qualifications

The following would further strengthen your application:
• Experience with the structural development of VTOL aircraft, helicopters, fixed-wing aircraft, UAVs or other lightweight aerospace systems is a plus
• Knowledge of EASA regulations and guidance material for UAS and eVTOL development, such as SORA, SC Light-UAS or SC-VTOL, is a valuable asset
• Experience with structural compliance demonstration, certification documentation and coordination with certification authorities adds to your profile
• Familiarity with finite element and design tools such as ANSYS, Nastran, Abaqus, Siemens NX or comparable software strengthens your application
• Experience with composite manufacturing processes, bonded joints and mechanically fastened joints is an advantage
• Planning and conducting structural test campaigns, from test definition and readiness through execution and data evaluation, is something you have done before
• Experience in building up or growing an engineering team, including hiring and mentoring, rounds out your qualifications
• German language skills are an advantage

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company ev

Within the Finance & Spend Management LoB, you will be working in one of our three sales teams with a primary focus on Procurement, and be responsible for our portfolio including SAP Ariba and SAP Fieldglass. The SSE shapes transformative solutions and delivers measurable value to customers through thought leadership, innovation, and strategic execution—supporting both specific Lines of Business (LoB) and the overall “One SAP” strategy.

Key Responsibilities include

- Lead Efforts: Establish, develop, and expand market share for SAP’s Spend - Procurement solutions within named accounts in Germany
- Pipeline & Opportunity Management: Build and execute a strong pipeline for Spend to achieve the quarterly and yearly sales target.
- Account Ownership & Strategy: Serve as the LoB owner for assigned accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans that align with customer goals, business objectives and broader account plans by account team.
- Drive End-to-End Customer Value Journey with Domain Expertise: Provide solution area domain expertise and thought leadership to understand and address high-priority business challenges. Lead end-to-end process mapping and the customer value journey, owning the transformation roadmap for the LoB.
- Enablement, Demos & Prototypes: Support solution advisors to ensure demo system readiness and manage enablement programs. Collaborate with Demo & Learning teams to provide updated assets and trial environments as part of scalable enablement programs as well as customized demos, POCs and prototypes with customer specific data.
- Value Proposition & Executive Engagement: Collaborate with value advisors to create compelling narratives articulating ROI, value leakage and competitive advantages. Conduct strategic discovery, run value leakage, AOTP workshops and deliver persuasive pitches with ways of solving distinct customer business/buying-center challenges to accelerate executive buy-in and drive demand independently of RFPs.
- Commercial Negotiations: Navigate complex pricing and contractual discussions, balancing client expectations with organizational profitability and cloud revenue growth.
- Adoption & Consumption: Support Customer Success Management (CSM) communities, secure references, and manage escalations. Collaborate with CS and CS&D adoption teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and services, monitoring outcomes and driving continuous improvement to maximize customer value.
- Customer Success & Field Impact: Own LoB deal cycles, renewals, enablement, and executive engagement. Elevate customer discussions to prioritize investment and drive measurable outcomes.
- Relationship Building & Governance: Drive C-suite engagements and Buying Center Alignment by fostering long-term high-value relationships and convert executives into advocates and brand ambassadors. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers and internal stakeholders focused on solution adoption, innovation, risks and opportunities.
- Ecosystem & Partner Engagement: Own relationships with strategic consulting partners (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY) to co-innovate, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and shape disruptive solutions. Maintain direct, high-quality relationships with partner account leads.
- Collaboration & Orchestration: Align closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure SAL impact is fully integrated into the go-to-market engine with tailored GTM approach. Drive joint accountability and coordination across internal stakeholders for maximum market impact.
- Competitive & Industry Expertise: Maintain deep technical and functional knowledge across SAP solutions. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and competitive trends to craft differentiated solutions that win in the market.

Position Summary

The Sr Specialist Compliance (m/f/d) ensures compliance with global material and environmental regulations such as REACH, RoHS, and TSCA. The role manages compliance processes, maintains material data and documentation, and supports regulatory reporting. Working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, the position identifies compliance risks and drives mitigation actions. It acts as a key interface for regulatory, customer, and sustainability-related requirements.

Responsibilities 

- Monitoring, assessment, and practical interpretation of international regulations and standards (e.g. REACH, RoHS, TSCA, Proposition 65).
- Establishment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of a Material Compliance Management System, including related processes and workflows.
- Collection, validation, and archiving of material data (material declarations, analysis certificates, SDS, etc.).
- Preparation of compliance reports and product declarations for internal stakeholders and customers.
- Support and coordination of supplier management activities, including supplier inquiries, evaluation of incoming data, and follow-up on missing information.
- Cross-functional collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Product Management, and other departments to implement compliance requirements.
- Identification of compliance risks arising from new regulatory requirements or non-compliant materials, and development of concrete mitigation and action plans.
- Communication with authorities, customers, and testing bodies; handling of customer inquiries related to material compliance.
- Contribution to the maintenance of sustainability and compliance platforms (e.g. EcoVadis) and preparation for external audits and assessments.

Qualifications

- Several years of professional experience in Material Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, or related functions are strongly recommended.
- Technical education in materials science, environmental engineering, technical chemistry, or a comparable field.
- Strong ability to analyze regulatory texts and legislation and to correctly translate requirements into product-specific contexts.
- Experience in handling material data and documentation systems; structured working style and strong quality orientation.
- Excellent communication skills (internal and external) and experience in working with suppliers and authorities.
- Independent working style, confident professional demeanor, and the ability to represent compliance requirements internally with the necessary level of assertiveness.
- Very good German and good English skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

- Environmental auditor qualification or comparable certification.
- Experience with material databases and EHS modules.
- Experience with sustainability or supply chain platforms (e.g. EcoVadis, IMDS, or similar).
- Knowledge of risk analysis and CAPA management.
